scientific_integrity: Universal claims are proved analytically using the published free-lattice norm model; finite exact checker supports illustrative identities and is not a completeness certificate.
scientific_limitations: Real scalar finite-coordinate free p-convex Banach lattices only; invariant subgroup must be transitive. Possible equivalent symmetrization in unindexed sources is an originality risk.
title: Transitive permutation invariants of free \(p\)-convex Banach lattices are isometric AM-spaces
